svg.title: The Architect — full system layer map with hook taxonomy
svg.desc: Eight layers from Constraint Field (L0) to SNR Gate (L7), with hook registry and wire taxonomy in the center. Each layer contains its key surfaces. Gates appear between layers as checkpoints.
svg.text: constraint-first system authoring environment · spec → hooks → map → schema → cli → ui → snr

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the Constraint Field in The Architect — Field, Constraint, Transition, Gap, Lens, History, Meaning?')
g.text: Field · Constraint · Transition · Observation · Lens · Gap · History · Meaning

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the Spec Engine in The Architect — Blueprint, Compress, Clip, Reconstruct, Translate, Behavior?')
sendPrompt('What does Blueprint do in The Architect — structural digest, shape without implementation, fromSpec/fromSession/fromKernel?')
sendPrompt('What does Compress do in The Architect — .urck, .nex artifacts, 5-12x compression, version gate?')
sendPrompt('What is a Clip in The Architect — bounded causal segment, from/to event index, replayable, diffable?')
sendPrompt('What does Reconstruct do in The Architect — rewind, replay, LCP, divergence detection?')
sendPrompt('What does Translate do in The Architect — UTL, field→schema, clip→timeline, seam→js?')
sendPrompt('What does Behavior do in The Architect — .beh assets, macro detection, tacit knowledge, deploy/recover?')
sendPrompt('What is the Hook Registry in The Architect — all inter-surface wires declared here, 22 hook types, validated before any binding is active?')
g.text: all inter-surface communication declared here · no hook = no wire · §I-1 · §I-3

svg.text: gate: topology validated · no dangling surfaces · §I-3

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Topology Mapper do in The Architect — scan files, detect data flows, find gaps, export as SVG/mermaid?')
g.text: mandatory first step after spec · maps before build

svg.text: gate: schemas match topology · no undeclared surfaces

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the Schema Builder do in The Architect — generate JSON Schema, TypeScript types, validators, constraint gates from topology?')
g.text: JSON Schema · TypeScript types · validators · gates · generated from topology

svg.text: gate: CLI built before UI · same schema · §4.1 · §I-13

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What CLI commands does The Architect provide — spec, hook, blueprint, map, schema, session, behavior, translate, snr, ollama, raid?')
g.text: L5 — CLI (peer to UI · built first · same schema)

svg.text: architect spec · hook · blueprint · map · schema · session · behavior · translate · snr · ollama · raid · serve
full feature parity with UI · §4.1 · no UI-only operations
gate: UI receives same schema as CLI · §I-13

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What panels does The Architect UI have — Blueprint viewer, Hook inspector, Timeline, Topology map, Schema builder, SNR dashboard?')

svg.text: gate: SNR score required · score < 0.45 → hold · no raw output to Ollama or RAID · §I-6 · §I-15

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the SNR Gate do in The Architect — score 0..1 across 8 axes, recommend send/hold/rewrite/flag, route to Ollama or RAID?')
g.text: L7 — Signal / Noise Gate (last surface before output)

svg.text: §A-1 architecture before implementation · §A-2 hooks are the wire · §A-3 map before build · §A-4 spec is living · §A-5 signal before noise
meaning is downstream of constraints · nothing pretends to work · the spec is the system · code is a projection
